title: sf-releaselens: a read-only Chrome side panel for Salesforce release managers
description: sf-releaselens is a Manifest V3 Chrome side panel that gives Salesforce release managers one surface for what is in flight, what a release actually contains, and what is awaiting their approval, beside the org tab they already have open. It is strictly read-only: the interface it uses to reach Salesforce exposes no post, patch, or delete member, it requests no host permission until an org is connected, it never polls, and opt-in telemetry is off by default. It has been validated against ten real Salesforce orgs.
